dict.string: DailyVox needs microphone access to record your voice diary entries.
DailyVox uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice recordings into text.
DailyVox uses Face ID to lock and unlock access to your private diary entries.
DailyVox lets you attach photos to your diary entries. Photos are stored on your device only.

DailyVox reads sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, steps, and mindful minutes to give your Digital Twin physiological context for each entry. Nothing leaves your device — all reads happen on iPhone and Apple's "Data Not Collected" privacy label is preserved.

DailyVox uses motion data to detect whether you're at rest or active when you record. This prevents a recording made during a workout from being mistaken for emotional stress. All motion classification happens on-device.
